prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported no visible damage to police at scene. Claimant has been identified as a third-party driver with a reported back strain. Claimant is represented by counsel; all contact to be routed through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received notice of representation from claimant's attorney. Letter requests preservation of all vehicle data, photographs, dashcam footage, and the insured's statement. Litigation hold instructions sent to the claims team and the insured. Medical authorization requested from claimant's counsel for records related to the back strain.

Entry 3: Reviewed the police report. Officer notes both vehicles were in motion and contact occurred at the rear quarter panel of the claimant's vehicle and the front passenger side of the insured's vehicle. Liability preliminarily under review. Recorded statement from insured obtained with counsel notified of the request as a courtesy. Insured confirms signal was not used prior to the lane change.

Entry 4: Received initial medical summary from claimant's attorney indicating treatment for a lower back strain with physical therapy recommended. Records are under review by the injury evaluation unit. Requested itemized bills and prior treatment history for the same body region. Reserve reviewed and adjusted pending medical documentation.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant's counsel regarding outstanding records. Counsel advises treatment is ongoing and a demand package will follow once care concludes. Adjuster noted the file for reassessment upon receipt of the demand. No settlement discussions have taken place at this time. Next diary set for review of the medical records once received.
